Sheet 03

How an engagement runs

4-stage build sequence
01

Audit

Map every tracking point across web, ads, CRM, and payments — and flag where events are missing, duplicated, or mismatched.

02

Architect

Design the event schema and data flow: what fires where, what gets deduplicated, and what lands in the warehouse.

03

Build

Implement GTM containers, server endpoints, CAPI connections, and any custom API bridges the stack needs.

04

Validate

Cross-check event match quality, dashboard totals, and platform reporting until the numbers agree.
